Primary request: a much warmer, more immersive, specifically Korean retreat in rain, as if I am actually sitting comfortably INSIDE a small Korean wooden countryside cottage on Jeju, looking OUT through a large rain-speckled window. Natural raindrops and rivulets on the glass feel close enough to touch; beyond, soft daylight reveals a gentle garden with a low irregular Jeju basalt stone wall, glossy camellia leaves, soft green grasses and familiar Korean broadleaf trees. Interior: warm honey-toned aged timber sill and window surround, a little smooth wooden floor visible at the bottom, a soft oatmeal linen curtain gathered naturally at one side, a small low wooden tea table cropped into the near foreground with just one simple warm cream ceramic cup of gently steaming tea. A small edge of a comfortable cream floor cushion suggests a Korean ondol room. Sparse, quiet, lived-in Korean countryside feeling, not a staged Scandinavian chalet. Soft amber room lighting from outside the frame gives believable warmth to the wood and fabric. Strong sense of being sheltered, dry, secure and relaxed while hearing the rain outside.

Style: extremely realistic premium slow-travel photography, tactile wood, linen and ceramic, natural exposure, inviting warm beige and honey indoors contrasted with gentle fresh greens and pale rainy daylight outside. Primary request: an immersive first-person view while taking a quiet early-morning walk along a gentle Jeju woodland path. Low irregular dark-gray porous basalt dry-stone walls characteristic of Jeju, moss lightly on the stones, run naturally alongside part of the path. Native-looking rounded broadleaf woodland, glossy camellia leaves, a few softly shaped Korean pines in the background, lush but friendly low grasses. Moderate-height trees and light open canopy; pale morning sky is visible between leaves. No huge straight western spruce/redwood trunks.
Mood and light: the reassuring fresh start of a mild Korean dawn, soft pale apricot sunlight diffused through the leaves, gentle dew, only a trace of delicate morning haze. Fresh sage and natural warm green, subtle gray basalt and sandy earth, soft warm cream highlights. Airy, safe, peaceful and gently luminous; enough daylight to see every part of the trail. Natural brightness rather than dark blue night. No thick fog or shafts of harsh supernatural light.
Composition: one full bleed very tall 2:5 portrait photograph, ideally 1024x2560. The path begins at the bottom center and draws the viewer into the central 30-65% vertical area; low stone walls and foliage stay comfortably in central 70% width for narrow card cropping. Keep the path open and unobstructed, no looming tunnel, no jagged roots or steep rocks. Upper and lower regions remain quieter for app copy rendered separately, but do not darken the whole scene. Beautiful gentle depth and a tangible sense of actually being on the trail.
